items.name: an-button
items.title: AnButton
items.description: `<an-button>` — an action element backed by a real native `<button>` inside the shadow root, so focus, keyboard activation and accessibility come from the platform.

attributes.name: variant
attributes.description: Visual intent. Default: "default".

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Control size. Default: "md".

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the native button and blocks `an-button-click`/form submission.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Marks the button busy with `aria-busy="true"` and blocks clicks.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: "submit" submits the owning form via `requestSubmit()`; "reset" resets it. Default: "button".

events.name: an-button-click
events.description: Fired when the user activates the button; `detail.originalEvent` is the native MouseEvent.

slots.description: Default slot: the button label (text, icon, or both).

cssProperties.name: --an-button-height
cssProperties.description: Control height; defaults to 2.25rem (2rem sm, 2.75rem lg).

cssProperties.name: --an-button-radius
cssProperties.description: Corner radius; defaults to 0.5rem (0.375rem sm, 0.625rem lg).

cssProperties.name: --an-button-font-size
cssProperties.description: Label font size; defaults to 0.875rem (0.8125rem sm, 1rem lg).

items.name: an-checkbox
items.title: AnCheckbox
items.description: `<an-checkbox>` — a boolean form control drawn in the shadow root around a native `<input type="checkbox">`, so focus, Space toggling and the accessible checked state all come from the platform.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Checked state; a user toggle writes the attribute back and `form.reset()` restores the mounted initial value. Default: false.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Bars interaction, constraint validation and form submission; also mirrored from a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>`. Default: false.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Participates in constraint validation (`valueMissing` when unchecked). Default: false.

attributes.name: indeterminate
attributes.description: Visual-only mixed state (`aria-checked="mixed"`); the next user click clears it and it is never submitted. Default: false.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Field name used when the value is submitted with the owning form.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted while the box is checked. Default: "on".

events.name: an-checkbox-change
events.description: Fired after a user toggle; `detail` carries `checked`, `value` and `originalEvent`.

cssProperties.name: --an-checkbox-accent
cssProperties.description: Checked border and tick colour; defaults to `--an-color-accent-9`.

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: The painted box (a decorative sibling of the native input).

items.name: an-checkbox-group
items.title: AnCheckboxGroup
items.description: `<an-checkbox-group>` — form-associated container for a set of `<an-checkbox>` options.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name; each selected value is submitted under it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Comma-separated selected values (`value="a,b"`); reflected by `.value`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the whole group, including every child.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Requires at least one selection for form submission.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label of the group; also names the `group` for assistive tech.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Stacking direction of the options. Default: "vertical".

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Minimum number of selected options; `0` disables the check.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Maximum number of selected options; `0` means unlimited.

events.name: an-checkbox-group-change
events.description: Fired when the selection changes; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Outer wrapper around the label and the options.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible group label; rendered only when `label` is non-empty.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected day in `YYYY-MM-DD`; seeds the property, never written back.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest selectable day in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Latest selectable day in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controlled open state of the panel; reflect target of the `open` property.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Keeps the panel in flow and removes the trigger.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks every interaction and submission.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Shows the value but forbids picking or typing.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Reports `valueMissing` while no day is selected.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder of the text field.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Field name submitted with the owning form.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `sm` | `md` | `lg`.

attributes.name: first-day
attributes.description: Weekday column 0: `0` = Sunday, `1` = Monday (default).

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Display pattern; `YYYY`, `MM`, `M`, `DD` and `D` are replaced.

events.name: an-date-change
events.description: Fired when a day is picked, typed, cleared or reset; `detail: { value, originalEvent }`.

events.name: an-date-open
events.description: Fired when the popover panel opens.

events.name: an-date-close
events.description: Fired when the popover panel closes.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Optional label rendered above the trigger.

cssProperties.name: --an-date-muted-fg
cssProperties.description: Muted text (weekdays, outside days); defaults to `--an-color-gray-9`.

cssProperties.name: --an-date-today-ring
cssProperties.description: Ring drawn around today; defaults to `--an-color-accent-9`.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Wrapper around the label, the trigger and the panel.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible label; hidden while the `label` slot is empty.

cssParts.name: trigger
cssParts.description: The clickable field that opens the panel.

cssParts.name: header
cssParts.description: Month bar holding the title and the two arrows.

cssParts.name: day-outside
cssParts.description: Added to days of the neighbouring months.

cssParts.name: footer
cssParts.description: Bottom bar with the clear and today buttons.

attributes.name: start
attributes.description: Range start in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

attributes.name: end
attributes.description: Range end in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Earliest selectable day in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Latest selectable day in `YYYY-MM-DD`.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Controlled open state of the panel; reflect target of the `open` property.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Keeps the panel in flow and removes the trigger.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks every interaction and submission.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Reports `valueMissing` until both ends are set.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder of the text field; defaults to `开始日期 — 结束日期`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Field name submitted for the start day.

attributes.name: end-name
attributes.description: Field name submitted for the end day.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: `sm` | `md` | `lg`.

attributes.name: first-day
attributes.description: Weekday column 0: `0` = Sunday, `1` = Monday (default).

events.name: an-date-range-change
events.description: Fired when the range completes or clears; `detail: { start, end }`.

events.name: an-date-range-open
events.description: Fired when the popover panel opens.

events.name: an-date-range-close
events.description: Fired when the popover panel closes.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Optional label rendered above the trigger.

cssProperties.name: --an-date-range-in-range-bg
cssProperties.description: Background of days inside the range.

cssProperties.name: --an-date-range-today-ring
cssProperties.description: Ring drawn around today; defaults to `--an-color-accent-9`.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Wrapper around the label, the trigger and the panel.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible label; hidden while the `label` slot is empty.

cssParts.name: trigger
cssParts.description: The clickable field that opens the panel.

cssParts.name: header
cssParts.description: Month bar holding the title and the two arrows.

cssParts.name: day-outside
cssParts.description: Added to days of the neighbouring months.

cssParts.name: footer
cssParts.description: Bottom bar with the clear and today buttons.

items.name: an-field
items.title: AnField
items.description: `<an-field>` — layout and error display for one form control.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label text; the star follows it when `required` is set.

attributes.name: hint
attributes.description: Secondary help text shown under the control.

attributes.name: error
attributes.description: Forces the error message and wins over the captured one.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks the field as required for presentation (`aria-required`).

slots.description: The control the field wraps; every direct element child is treated as one.

cssProperties.name: --an-field-gap
cssProperties.description: Space between label, control, hint and error; defaults to `--an-space-2` (0.5rem).

cssProperties.name: --an-field-hint-color
cssProperties.description: Hint colour; defaults to `--an-color-fg-1` weakened to 62%.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Column wrapper around the label, control, hint and error.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The `<label>`; rendered empty and hidden when `label` is unset.

cssParts.name: required
cssParts.description: The `*` after the label text; rendered only when `required` is set.

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: Wrapper around the `<slot>`; carries `data-invalid` while an error shows.

cssParts.name: hint
cssParts.description:
The `

` hint; hidden while `hint` is empty.

cssParts.name: error
cssParts.description:
The `

` error; hidden while no error shows.

items.name: an-form
items.title: AnForm
items.description: `<an-form>` — the container that gives custom controls form semantics without requiring a native `<form>`.

attributes.name: novalidate
attributes.description: Skip constraint validation on `submit()`, like the native attribute.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Marks a submission in flight; the form itself changes no behaviour and leaves the buttons untouched.

events.name: an-form-submit
events.description: Fired after a successful `submit()`; `detail = { formData, values }`.

events.name: an-form-invalid
events.description: Fired when `submit()` finds invalid controls; `detail = { fields }`.

events.name: an-form-reset
events.description: Fired after `reset()`; the detail is empty.

items.name: an-input
items.title: AnInput
items.description: `<an-input>` — a single-line field backed by a real native `<input>` inside the shadow root, so focus, selection, IME, autofill, `type` semantics and the on-screen keyboard all come from the platform.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial value. The attribute is read once and never written back on input.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Native type forwarded to the inner `<input>`; unknown values fall back to "text". Default: "text".

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder text forwarded to the inner `<input>`.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label. When empty no `<label>` is rendered and `aria-label`/`aria-labelledby` are forwarded from the host instead.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Control size. Default: "md".

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the inner input and blocks `an-input`/`an-change`.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Makes the inner input read-only and blocks `an-input`/`an-change`.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Participates in constraint validation (`valueMissing` when empty).

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: External error state; maps to `aria-invalid="true"` and the error border.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Field name used when the value is submitted with the owning form.

events.name: an-input
events.description: Fired on every native input; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

events.name: an-change
events.description: Fired on native change (blur or Enter); `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

cssProperties.name: --an-input-height
cssProperties.description: Control height; defaults to 2.25rem (2rem sm, 2.75rem lg).

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Outer wrapper around the label and the control.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible `<label>`; rendered only when `label` is non-empty.

items.name: an-number
items.title: AnNumber
items.description: `<an-number>` — a numeric field backed by an internal `<input type="text" inputmode="decimal" role="spinbutton">`, so typing, selection, IME and the on-screen keyboard come from the platform.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial numeric text. It seeds the field and is never written back; use the `value` property to read the parsed number. The property also accepts a number or a numeric string (framework templates pass `value="3"` through as a string).

attributes.name: min
attributes.description: Minimum accepted value. Values below it are normalised to it and flagged `rangeUnderflow` until then. No default.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Maximum accepted value. Values above it are normalised to it and flagged `rangeOverflow` until then. No default.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Stepping interval for the arrow keys, the stepper buttons and `stepUp()`/`stepDown()`. Default: 1.

attributes.name: precision
attributes.description: Decimal places applied when the text is committed; trailing zeros are always dropped. No default (keeps the natural decimals).

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the field, drops it from `FormData` and from constraint validation.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Makes the field read-only: it still submits but is barred from constraint validation and from stepping.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Fails constraint validation with `valueMissing` while the field is empty.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Placeholder text forwarded to the internal input.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the `FormData` entry.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Control size. Default: "md".

attributes.name: stepper
attributes.description: Renders the up/down spin buttons, which also repeat while held.

events.name: an-number-change
events.description: The parsed value changed, on commit, on a keyboard/stepper step, or when `stepUp()`/`stepDown()` move it. Never fires when the parsed value stays the same.

slots.description: No slots are projected; the whole control is rendered in the shadow root.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: The wrapper around the input and the optional stepper.

cssParts.name: stepper
cssParts.description: The stepper wrapper, rendered only with `stepper`.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted when this option is selected. Default: the trimmed text content.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Prevents the option from being selected. Default: false.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Accessible name. Default: the trimmed text content.

slots.description: Option label, used when `label` and `value` are absent.

items.name: an-radio
items.title: AnRadio
items.description: `<an-radio>` — one option of a radio group.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Submitted value of the option.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Checked state, driven by the owning `<an-radio-group>`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the option and blocks selection.

events.name: an-radio-connect
events.description: Fired when the option connects, so a group can re-sync after a late upgrade.

events.name: an-radio-select
events.description: Fired when this option becomes checked; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

cssProperties.name: --an-radio-size
cssProperties.description: Edge length of the painted control; defaults to `--an-space-4` (1rem).

cssProperties.name: --an-radio-accent
cssProperties.description: Checked fill and border colour; defaults to `--an-color-accent-9`.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: The `<label>` wrapper around the control and the label text.

cssParts.name: control
cssParts.description: The painted radio control (a decorative sibling of the native input).

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The slot wrapper for the visible label text.

items.name: an-radio-group
items.title: AnRadioGroup
items.description: `<an-radio-group>` — the form-associated half of the radio pair.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Field name used when the value is submitted with the owning form.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected value, seeded by the attribute but never written back by the property.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label, also used to name the `radiogroup` for assistive technology.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables every option and clears the form entry and validity.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Participates in constraint validation (`valueMissing` when nothing is selected).

events.name: an-radio-change
events.description: Fired when the selection changes; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Outer wrapper around the label and the options.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible group label; rendered only when `label` is non-empty.

items.name: an-select
items.title: AnSelect
items.description: `<an-select>` — a self-drawn listbox with a light-DOM option source.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible label above the trigger. Default: empty.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text shown while nothing is selected. Default: empty.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Control size. Default: `md`.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. Default: empty.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Blocks interaction and form submission. Default: false.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks the field as mandatory. Default: false.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Applies the invalid styling and `aria-invalid`. Default: false.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial/current single value. The property never writes back the attribute.

attributes.name: values
attributes.description: Multi-select values, comma separated.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Turns the control into a multi-select. Default: false.

attributes.name: searchable
attributes.description: Renders a local search box in the panel. Default: false.

attributes.name: loading
attributes.description: Shows the loading row. Default: false.

attributes.name: virtual
attributes.description: Virtualization mode. Default: `auto`.

attributes.name: max-tags
attributes.description: Tags shown on a multi-select trigger before `+N`. Default: 3.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the panel is open. Reflected by the property.

events.name: an-select-change
events.description: User changed the selection. Detail: `{ value, values, option, originalEvent }`.

events.name: an-select-open
events.description: The panel opened.

events.name: an-select-close
events.description: The panel closed.

events.name: an-search
events.description: Debounced search query. Detail: `{ query }`.

slots.description: `<an-option>` or native `<option>` children; they stay in the light DOM.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: Column wrapper around the label and the control.

cssParts.name: tags
cssParts.description: Tag container on a multi-select trigger.

items.name: an-switch
items.title: AnSwitch
items.description: `<an-switch>` — an on/off control built on a native `<input type="checkbox">` with `role="switch"` inside the shadow root, so focus, Space toggling and the accessible checked state all come from the platform.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: On/off state; a user toggle writes the attribute back and `form.reset()` restores the mounted initial value. Default: false.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Bars interaction, constraint validation and form submission; also mirrored from a disabled ancestor `<fieldset>`. Default: false.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Participates in constraint validation (`valueMissing` when off). Default: false.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Field name used when the value is submitted with the owning form.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value submitted while the switch is on. Default: "on".

events.name: an-switch-change
events.description: Fired after a user toggle; `detail` carries `checked`, `value` and `originalEvent`.

items.name: an-textarea
items.title: AnTextarea
items.description: `<an-textarea>` — a multi-line field backed by a real native `<textarea>` inside the shadow root, so focus, selection, wrapping, IME, autofill, the `maxlength` counter and the on-screen keyboard all come from the platform.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Initial text; typed input does not write it back.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Hint shown while empty.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Visible `<label>` text; omitted when empty.

attributes.name: rows
attributes.description: Visible row count of the inner textarea. Default `3`.

attributes.name: maxlength
attributes.description: Maximum character count, forwarded to the inner textarea. `-1` means unlimited.

attributes.name: resize
attributes.description: Resize handles: `none`, `vertical` (default) or `both`.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Bars interaction, constraint validation and form submission.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Keeps the value submittable but exempts it from validation.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks the field as mandatory; blank (trimmed) values fail.

attributes.name: invalid
attributes.description: Renders the invalid state (`aria-invalid`).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Entry name used by the owning form's `FormData`.

events.name: an-textarea-input
events.description: On every input; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

events.name: an-textarea-change
events.description: On the native `change`; `detail = { value, originalEvent }`.

cssParts.name: base
cssParts.description: The wrapper around label and control.

cssParts.name: label
cssParts.description: The visible `<label>`; rendered only when `label` is non-empty.

items.name: an-upload
items.title: AnUpload
items.description: `<an-upload>` — file picker, drop target and upload queue in one control.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name and the default multipart field name.

attributes.name: accept
attributes.description: Comma-separated MIME types, `image/*` wildcards or `.ext` names.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Lets the picker and drop target accept more than one file.

attributes.name: max-files
attributes.description: Upper bound of queued files; `0` means unlimited.

attributes.name: max-size
attributes.description: Per-file upper bound in bytes; `0` means unlimited.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables picking, dropping and uploading.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Marks the control invalid while the queue is empty.

attributes.name: action
attributes.description: Upload endpoint; enables the built-in XHR uploader.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: HTTP method for `action`; defaults to `POST`.

attributes.name: field-name
attributes.description: Multipart field name; defaults to `name`.

attributes.name: auto-upload
attributes.description: Starts uploading as soon as files are added; defaults to `true`.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Control size: `sm`, `md` or `lg`.

events.name: an-upload-change
events.description: Files were added, removed or cleared; detail is `AnUploadChangeDetail`.

events.name: an-upload-reject
events.description: A file failed validation; detail is `AnUploadRejectDetail`.

events.name: an-upload-progress
events.description: Bytes were transferred; detail is `AnUploadProgressDetail`.

events.name: an-upload-success
events.description: A file finished; detail is `AnUploadSuccessDetail`.

events.name: an-upload-error
events.description: A file failed; detail is `AnUploadErrorDetail`.

events.name: an-upload-abort
events.description: A running upload was cancelled; detail is `AnUploadAbortDetail`.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: Replaces the default button and hint inside the dropzone.

cssProperties.name: --an-upload-gap
cssProperties.description: Gap between the dropzone and the list.

cssParts.name: trigger
cssParts.description: Default "choose file" button (absent when `trigger` is slotted).

cssParts.name: item-size
cssParts.description: Human-readable file size of an item.

cssParts.name: item-progress
cssParts.description: Progress bar track of an item.

cssParts.name: item-cancel
cssParts.description: Cancel button, rendered only while uploading.

cssParts.name: empty
cssParts.description: Placeholder shown while the queue is empty.
